bibliographic.title: Diviner
bibliographic.author: Josh Labelle
bibliographic.description:
DIVINER is a short text adventure set mostly in one room in which you pace, receive divine omens, and interact with a capricious God.

Can you divine enough omens to save your small village from cataclysm? Does your village even deserve to be saved?

http://philome.la/JoshMLabelle/d-i-v-i-n-e-r/play
